scope.inventory_overlap: The five identities were already in the affected312 and prior49 prepared routes. These replacements do not add another five frozen identities.

upstream.scope: Computed package SHA256 values match independent publisher API digests; packaged PE files are AMD64. Git-blob source binding does not establish source/binary equivalence.

shared_contract.sdk: existing Native4; no new engine, console primitive or validator relaxation
shared_contract.coordinates: Each entry owns a separate flat official package, selected setup executable parent as CWD, declared private data, originals directory and saves directory. TEMP/TMP=. scope fixed temporary witnesses to that runtime.
shared_contract.entry: Play opens the corresponding upstream setup/launch controller. Warp selects detected IWAD names; the PWAD/mod browser is not an original-file browser. No automated source preparation or authenticated original admission is claimed.

lifetime.contract: The Windows controller retains and waits its launched player process before returning.
lifetime.limit: mainmenu.c164-182 and multiplayer.c212-296 can return zero regardless of inner player failure. Controller completion is not game startup, gameplay or inner-game exit qualification.

shared_contract.original_data: Only deliberate copies of matching lawful original IWADs into the declared originals directory, or recognized external upstream installations. DOOMWADDIR=originals uses the existing upstream search contract and covers original filenames of arbitrary case inside that directory. No populated data/profile adoption, source conversion or cross-variant save compatibility.
shared_contract.external_data: Upstream may read/write its SDL music-pack profile and custom paths outside the installation on Play. Those remain externally owned and excluded from Core backup/rollback. Custom outputs inside the installation outside declared paths are unclaimed and may hold maintenance. No populated profile is adopted.
shared_contract.maintenance: Use the existing compatible-release GitHub provider and independently expected digest. Keep creating runtime/data identities and existing interruption/recovery, inventory and activation guards. This is not a promise of arbitrary future save compatibility.
shared_contract.final_doom: #2656 remains on its existing upstream-owned route until TNT/Plutonia campaign selection, independent save namespaces and exact retained coordinates are qualified. No campaign remapping or populated-data expansion is inferred.
shared_contract.renderer_request: SDL_RENDER_DRIVER=direct3d11 is an explicit creating-definition request. The observed setup-only control uses that same request; actual renderer selection and game rendering are not inferred.
shared_contract.source_variant_isolation: Different title IDs retain separate entry data. Retained versions of the same canonical ID share that entry data; use a separate Portcove library or independently owned upstream copy for another original edition. Do not switch populated source variants in place.

retained_selected_fixture.contract: Exact five old operational objects, separate from managed defaults. Existing49 acceptance cases remain, using the two reviewed creating-definition snapshots without per-title production branches.

failures_preserved: Version harness first attempt rejected a case-insensitive PowerShell variable collision before player execution; no player observation credited.

Default-renderer setup capture was black using PrintWindow and an owned foreground screen capture; synthetic normal quit did not produce exit. The failed/Unknown receipt remains unchanged. A minimal local dump showed the main thread in the SDL message wait; it does not establish an application deadlock.

Exact task-owned setup process was terminated only after path/hash/start/retained-handle validation and local minimal dumps; complete Root/descendant drain was verified. Both observer-owned native locks were recovered with exact owner preimages and reverse release. This is cleanup, not normal shutdown qualification.

Software retry correctly refused the first run’s task-created profile before player execution. A later continuation bound exact original receipt, README hash/creation and the known MSIX physical target before/after.
Computer Use failed to initialize (Windows sandbox cwd URI; WSL trusted-service configuration). No Computer Use app input executed; configuration was not widened.
Requested Direct3D11 retry was refused before lease/player because another worktree owned the native session.
